Name: Harvey's SM Dialogue (Official English Translation)
Author: PumpkinPatch404
Description:
A mod that changes Harvey's dialogues into a SM Relationship.
Should be compatible with any Smapi/Stardew version.

Compatible for all platforms (Mobile and PC)

Made by Veronnica0504 (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/132251638) originally Chinese, translated with permission in English (I got confirmation in the mod comments section and in private, Veronnica0504 assisted me with the translation and without her help I wouldn't have been able to finish it)

The mod was initially only for female farmers and I adapted it so that male and non-binary farmers can be addressed properly.
If there's any mistake or error please let me know.

How to Install:

Must have Content Patcher.
Install ONLY ONE version (Either SM Harvey or Gentle SM Harvey)
Locate your Stardew Valley folder.
Unzip in your mod folder.
Start the game.


You don't need the original mod to make this work.

Be careful when you choose your file.
Relatively SM Harvey and Gentle SM Harvey are the same, but there's some small differences in how Harvey behaves to you.


I didn't make the mod, so for any question about the mod and story itselt it would be best to ask the creator.

For now I can give a general description.

You and Harvey had a online "relationship" before you moved to the valley, the relationship isn't romantic/mutually exclusive until later on.


If you're not comfortable with your MC sleeping around while being with Harvey (when not dating) I would suggest to not install this mod, because a lot of dialogues will mention that.

The mod isn't like the washed down versions of SM relationships in fiction, rather it's quite graphic and "violent" depending on the person.
For a better understanding read the mod author info's about the mod (translate the page from Chinese to English if possible)

Mod page:

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22072?tab=description


Picture used for the mod is temporary as I can't currently use my Smapi as I still have to update it.

The portraits were made by Veronnica0504.
Her page already linked the portraits mod but I'll be linking those as well here:

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21741
